decision: Selected the Iowa DNR facility point of the active Title V air source 'Apple WKE Data Center Campus' at 2995 W Hickman Rd, Waukee (stfacid 310199906, programme ID 25-06-017) as the campus locator for Apple's Waukee data-centre campus (Project Morgan).

selected_properties.PIStartDt: 2023-04-27 (epoch ms 1682604281000; the Meta Altoona Title V record carries the same day, so this looks like a register migration date, not an operating-start date)
selected_properties.spatial_reference: outSR=4326 (WGS84) as returned by the Iowa DNR OneStop IaFmFacilities MapServer, layer 0 (air facilities)

stormwater_315329305.facName: Project Morgan Apple Inc. Data Center - Construction
stormwater_315329305.permitDesc: CONSTRUCTION OF A DATA CENTER WITH ASSOCIATED PARKING LOTS, PRIVATE DRIVES AND UTILITIES

computed.method: Point geometry and attributes as returned by the Iowa DNR service in WGS84 (outSR=4326); geodesic distances on the WGS84 ellipsoid with pyproj 3.7.1 Geod. The storm-water record is placed only to a quarter section (Accuracy 570) and is identity context, not the locator. No county parcel layer could be used: Dallas County publishes parcels only through the Beacon application behind a disclaimer page, which was not used.
